atmosfera: thick fog after midnight, quiet and suspicious, rain falling in fine mist, condensation on surfaces, the air heavy with the smell of wet concrete and old metal, dust and condensation floating in the air
prompt_visual: A woman emerges from black water at low tide, her body half-lit by a brass diving lamp held high. The lamp's beam cuts through fog and rain, casting long shadows across a floating wooden and metal structure over the bay. Exposed beams, rusted supports, drifting debris. A cracked stone staircase descends into the black, edges worn smooth. A floating doll's house rests on the surface, one wall broken, windows dark, roof listing. Old apartment blocks rise from the bay, balconies bare, laundry lines with wet fabric, one family photo drying, edges curled and water-stained. A rowing boat, half-sunk, drifts near a street lamp, oars tangled in weeds. A cracked satellite dish hovers above, suspended by thick rusted cables anchored to rooftops, its core pulsing with magenta light that flickers in rhythm with the rain. The light reflects in fractured waves, catching a faded Polaroid photo tucked inside a yellow vinyl raincoat, edges smudged with water and time. The air is thick with floating dust and condensation. The only sound is the slow drip of water from the dish's frame. The woman's wetsuit clings to her skin, hair tangled and dripping. Her left hand grips the brass diving lamp, right presses a flat object against her chest, clutching the raincoat. The magenta pulse matches the rhythm of the photo's hidden memory. Original machine design.
